svg.title: How PrefillAdder admits requests
svg.desc: 1 · Budget starts from free slots plus what the tree can evict
svg.text: 1 · Budget starts from free slots plus what the tree can evict
KV pool slots of one GPU · page_size 1
rem_total_tokens counts slots the tree can free on demand, not only empty ones.
Evicting a lock_ref 0 leaf only drops cached prefix KV, so the scheduler counts it as room.
